audit.why: The full layer's phases[].side and the content layer's win[] already agree row for row: Tryndamere, Tryndamere, Tryndamere, Tryndamere, Gwen, Skill, Tryndamere. diff is FAV at 6/10 against a 53.12% win rate, which is consistent, and the mirrored gwen__tryndamere audit set its own side to HARD 7/10 — the inverse, as it should be. The mirror's summary does not list the row values it settled on, so I did not move rows on a guess.

Hallowed Mist 22/21/20/19/18s, Skip 'n Slash 13/12.5/12/11.5/11s (partially refunded on hit), Snip Snip! 6.5s down to 3.5s, Needlework 120/100/80s with three casts off one press. Both ultimates share the same 120/100/80 line.
audit.corrected: Numbers written into spikes[0], spikes[1] and breakdown.cooldowns.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[0] tells you to 'dash in past her W Hallowed Mist'. You cannot. Spinning Slash requires a target unit, and inside the mist she can only be targeted by enemies who are also inside it.
audit.why: Riot's text: 'Gwen summons mist that protects her from enemies outside of it. She can only be targeted by enemies who enter the mist.' So the mist does not dodge your gap-close — it removes it. You have to walk in, or spin to a minion standing inside. That is the decisive interaction of the matchup and the page had it backwards.
audit.corrected: Spinning Slash needs a target, so Hallowed Mist does not dodge it — it disables your gap-close.

audit.whatIsWrong: Snip Snip!'s true damage and A Thousand Cuts' healing were never stated.
audit.why: Riot: 'Gwen deals true damage to units in the center' — armour is the wrong answer to her centre damage, Undying Rage is. And 'She heals for a portion of the damage dealt to champions by this effect' — her sustain rides on hitting you, which is what makes Grievous Wounds decide the late 1v1.
audit.corrected: The centre of Snip Snip! is true damage; A Thousand Cuts heals her off every hit, so Executioner's is not optional.

audit.why: Its attack-damage reduction is dead weight against an AP Gwen, and its movement slow only applies to enemies with their backs turned — so the instinct to give ground is what makes it useless.
audit.corrected: Mocking Shout's AD cut is dead weight on an AP Gwen, and its slow only lands with her back turned.

audit.why: Riot's text gives it damage, a slow and a passive application, cast up to three times — no execute threshold. It also means your ult should ride the whole chain, not answer the first needle.
audit.corrected: Needlework fires three times off one 120s cast — ride the chain out.

edits.before: With E Spinning Slash you can dash in past her W Hallowed Mist, but note the fog makes her untargetable by autos while she stands in it — force the trade as she steps out to CS, since her Q snips out-poke you if you sit in range.
edits.after: Spinning Slash needs a target unit, so Hallowed Mist does not just dodge it — it turns your gap-close off entirely. The mist is stationary on a 22s cooldown: step in on foot, or spin to a minion inside it, and trade when she walks out to farm.

edits.before: R Undying Rage is your trump card: Gwen's kill relies on Q Snip Snip! shred plus R Needlework poke, but you pop immortality, ride out her burst, and heal back with Q Bloodlust before her Mist is up again.
edits.after: Snip Snip! centre damage is true, so armour does nothing — Undying Rage is the answer, not resists. Needlework fires three times off one 120s cast, so ride the whole chain out rather than ulting on the first needle.

edits.before: Gwen out-scales most bruisers, but you specifically counter her: R negates her Needlework execute and your continuous crit sustain wins the extended fight as long as you don't waste E into her Mist.
edits.after: A Thousand Cuts heals her off every auto she lands on you, so Executioner's is not optional late — without it her sustain outlasts Bloodlust. Fight her where the mist is already spent.

edits.before: Even into her scaling, you hold the edge — R Undying Rage eats her Q shred and R Needlework burst, and your crit autos plus Bloodlust healing grind her down whenever you can pull her off her Mist.
edits.after: You hold the edge, but not through resists — her Q centre is true damage and her passive scales off your health. Buy Grievous Wounds, hold Undying Rage for the Needlework chain, and never aim your spin at her mist.

edits.before: - Gwen Hallowed Mist: matchup-defining — She’s safe inside it. Fight when down. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Hallowed Mist (W): 22s at rank 1 — inside it she can only be targeted from inside it. - Skip 'n Slash (E): 13s, refunded in part if she lands a hit. - Snip Snip! (Q): 6.5s at rank 1, true damage in the centre.

edits.before: Trade strictly around Hallowed Mist: when it is down, run your full pattern; when it is up, give nothing. If ahead, freeze and starve him.
edits.after: Trade around Hallowed Mist's 22s. Mocking Shout's AD cut is dead weight on an AP Gwen, and its slow only lands with her back turned.

edits.before: She’s safe inside it. Fight when down. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Hallowed Mist is 22s and stationary — walk in on foot or wait it out.

edits.before: That is Gwen's favourite window — refuse it and half his win condition is gone.
edits.after: Inside the mist she can fight you; outside it you cannot touch her at all.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: The centre of Snip Snip! is true damage — armour will not save you.

edits.before: Track Gwen's Hallowed Mist: She’s safe inside it. Fight when down. When it is down — Crit her down.
edits.after: Spinning Slash needs a target, so Hallowed Mist does not dodge it — it disables your gap-close.
